headline: Earnings surge, AFFO grows, and full-year outlook improves
summary_short: Realty Income earned $0.37 per diluted share on net income of $344.0 million in Q2 2026, up 68% and 75% y/y, as revenue rose 9.7% to $1.55 billion and AFFO per share grew 3.8% to $1.09; the company raised its 2026 AFFO-per-share guidance to $4.44-$4.45.
summary_long: Net income rose to $344.0 million ($0.37/share) from $196.9 million ($0.22/share) a year ago, and AFFO per share grew 3.8% to $1.09, driven by $2.6 billion of new investment (Pro-Rata $2.1 billion) at a 7.3% initial cash yield and a 102.7% rent-recapture rate on re-leased space. Portfolio occupancy was 98.8%, versus 98.9% last quarter and 98.6% a year ago. Realty Income raised full-year 2026 AFFO-per-share guidance to $4.44-$4.45 from $4.41-$4.44, citing its resilient core portfolio and contributions from its hyperscale data-center joint venture and investment-management platform. Leverage stood at 5.4x net debt/EBITDAre. Cash fell to $552.6 million from $800.4 million a year ago on investment activity, a €600 million note issuance, and an upsized $5.5 billion July credit facility.

drivers.explanation: Results reflect the diversified portfolio's strength and disciplined capital allocation, with the recently announced hyperscale data-center joint venture and the Investment Management platform cited as new growth channels.
Growth was supported by $2.6 billion invested in the quarter (Pro-Rata $2.1 billion) at a 7.3% initial weighted average cash yield, per the release's investment summary.
EPS growth tracks the rise in net income; weighted diluted shares also grew 3.4% y/y from equity issuance, which partially offset per-share gains versus net income's growth.
Net income rose as impairment provisions fell to $54.2 million from $142.3 million a year ago, even as interest expense rose to $312.1 million from $283.8 million, per the income statement.
Improvement tracks the same lower impairment provisions plus $38.3 million of gains on real estate sales, per the consolidated income statement.
Share count grew after Realty Income raised $843.0 million this quarter through the sale of common stock, primarily via forward sale agreements under its ATM program.
